name: codex-radar
description: Analyze your local Codex collaboration history across 9 dimensions in 3 categories (Communication / Engineering / Outcome): your Codex model scores the sessions and writes a diagnosis with paste-ready prompt rewrites, rendered as a single-file HTML dashboard. 100% local.

interface.longDescription: Codex Radar reads your local Codex session JSONL files. A deterministic parser extracts the facts, then your own Codex model scores collaboration across 9 dimensions in 3 categories against a transparent rubric, writes a free-form diagnosis, and renders a single-file HTML dashboard with evidence and paste-ready improvement prompts. The plugin makes no network calls of its own and needs no separate API key — the analysis runs inside your Codex session.
defaultPrompt: Run Codex Radar on this project
